Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, each configured to be cured on respective first and second layers; a medial section positioned between the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer.

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal honeycomb structure.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the ring includes a central opening.
